fixture: Integrator settling bench (issue #53): full integrator cell + ota_fd, integrate phase, 0.45 V per-side output step

pass_criterion: err_phase <= 1e-4 (residual error at 97.66 ns after the phi2 edge, relative to the settled differential step) at every corner, plus the two reference-validity gates
